links.surface: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْحِمْيَرِيُّ
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَصَمِّ

notes: «عَنْ أَبِيهِ» names the father only as a relation: relation (rule 7)
The Imam is named after «عن», so he stays narrator (ruling 2); the blessing is left out
«قَالَ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ» is inside the saying, so the man in it is not a link
